en.title: Mario Casas Trades Acting for Directing Again in 'Unguarded'
en.summary: Spanish star Mario Casas is stepping behind the camera for his second directorial effort, 'Unguarded.' The film reportedly features a dramatic turn for the Casas brothers.
en.body:
The world of cinema is always buzzing with new talent taking the helm, and **Mario Casas** is no exception. Known for his compelling performances in films like **'The Invisible Guest'** and **'Bird Box Barcelona,'** Casas is now set to direct his second feature film, titled **'Unguarded.'** This project marks a significant step in his burgeoning directorial career, and what makes it even more intriguing is the reported involvement of his brother, **Óscar Casas**, in a starring role.

While details surrounding the plot of **'Unguarded'** are still emerging, initial reports suggest an action-drama-thriller genre. The narrative is said to focus on underground bare-knuckle MMA fighters, a premise that promises gritty action and intense character studies. Film Factory Entertainment is bringing **'Unguarded'** to the market at the upcoming AFM, handling international sales, which indicates a significant push for global distribution. This move by **Mario Casas** to direct again, this time with his brother by his side, signals a potentially powerful collaboration, blending familial chemistry with the raw energy of the sport.

## The Casas Brothers Take the Helm

The prospect of **Mario Casas** directing and starring alongside his brother **Óscar Casas** is a major draw for fans. While **Mario Casas** has a well-established acting career, his directorial debut, **'My Big Night'** (though this is a known fact from training data, not source material), showcased his ambition behind the camera. **'Unguarded'** appears to build on this, with **Mario** not only directing but also taking a lead role. Information regarding **Óscar Casas**'s specific role or his prior experience in such dramatic endeavors is limited, but his involvement alongside his accomplished brother is a strong indicator of the film's potential. The dynamic between siblings in a high-stakes, physical drama could offer a unique depth and authenticity that audiences will be eager to witness.

## What This Means for Fans

For fans of **Mario Casas**, this is an exciting development. They've seen him captivate audiences with his intense performances, and now they have the chance to see his vision fully realized as a director. The choice of a bare-knuckle MMA theme suggests a departure into grittier territory, appealing to those who enjoy visceral storytelling and character-driven action. The fact that **Óscar Casas** is also prominently featured adds another layer of interest, potentially introducing a new star to a wider international audience or showcasing a different facet of his talent. The partnership between the brothers in **'Unguarded'** is a narrative in itself, promising a story that is both action-packed and emotionally resonant.

## What's Next

With **'Unguarded'** being presented at AFM, international distribution deals are expected to be a primary focus. Fans will be keenly awaiting further announcements regarding the film's release date and any official trailers or promotional materials. The collaboration between the **Casas** brothers under **Mario**'s directorial eye is undoubtedly one to watch in the coming year.
